ep01-what-is-chance-02.jpg:
**Someone puts up a prize. You decide if it's worth taking.**
Creators fund the prize and set the entry price, odds and rules. You see all of it before you enter.

**1. The prize:** Funded by the creator before anyone enters.
**2. Your odds:** On the page before you pay. Here, 1 in 500.
**3. Entry price:** What one entry costs. Here, 40 USDG.
ep01-what-is-chance-03.jpg:
**Two ways to play.**

**Instant Win:** Pick a number. Match the winning number and you take the whole prize. Then the Chance ends.
**MultiWin:** Pick four digits. The more positions you match, the bigger the prize, and the Chance keeps going.
ep01-what-is-chance-04.jpg:
**Every entry, result and payout is public.**
Chance runs on Robinhood Chain, so anyone can look any of it up.

• Prize funded
• Odds visible
• Result checkable
• Public record

**Create a Chance. Or take one.**
**You decide.**

ep02-getting-set-up-02.jpg:
**Sign in the easy way.**
No crypto experience needed. Confirm you're 18+, then pick how to sign in.

**1. Email:** Type it in and a wallet is made for you.
**2. Google, X or Discord:** One tap, and a wallet is made for you too.
**3. Your own wallet:** Already have one? Connect it instead.
ep02-getting-set-up-03.jpg:
**Your wallet needs two things.**
Have both ready before your first entry.

**The Chance's token:** Each Chance shows its token, like USDG. Entries and payouts use it.
**A little ETH:** For gas and the randomness fee. Free entries need it too.
**Robinhood Chain only:** The same ticker on another network is a different token. It won't arrive.
ep02-getting-set-up-04.jpg:
**Your keys stay yours.**
Chance never holds your private key, not even for the wallet made at sign-in. Lost access? Sign in again with the same account to get the same wallet.

• Chance never asks for your seed phrase
• 18+, only where it's allowed
• No ID documents needed

**Create a Chance. Or take one.**

ep03-reading-a-chance-02.jpg:
**Every number, before you pay.**
Remember this card? Here's what the other numbers mean.

**1. 1 in 500:** Your odds of winning with one entry.
**2. 60% RTP:** Built to pay back 60% of entry spend over many entries. An average, not a promise.
**3. 389/1,000:** Entries so far, out of a cap of 1,000.
**4. 300×:** The prize is 300 times the entry price.
ep03-reading-a-chance-03.jpg:
**MultiWin cards show four tiers.**
Match more digits, win a bigger tier. Each badge shows the payout as a multiple of the entry price.

**1. T4: all four digits:** The top tier. Pays up to 50× your entry.
**2. T1: one digit:** ×4/10 means you get 4/10 of your entry back.
**3. Time left:** The Chance closes when the timer runs out.
ep03-reading-a-chance-04.jpg:
**Locked at launch.**
Price, odds, number range, duration and tiers can't change after a Chance is created. Not by the creator, not by Chance. A Chance closes when:

• Its timer runs out or it hits its entry cap
• An Instant Win is won
• A MultiWin runs low on funds

**Create a Chance. Or take one.**
**You decide.**

ep04-taking-an-instant-win-02.jpg:
**Entering takes a minute.**
Pick, then confirm in your wallet. The result usually lands within seconds.

**1. Check the odds:** Here, 1 in 500 per entry.
**2. Choose how many:** Up to 100 per purchase, never more than 40% of the numbers.
**3. Pick your numbers:** Type them in, or tap shuffle for random ones.
ep04-taking-an-instant-win-03.jpg:
**Match the number, take the prize.**

**The reveal:** Each purchase gets its own winning number. It usually lands within seconds.
**A match:** Match it and the whole prize is yours. The Chance ends there.
ep04-taking-an-instant-win-04.jpg:
**Any number, same odds.**
Birthday, lucky number or shuffle: your odds are the same. And your numbers never block anyone else's.

• Up to 100 entries per purchase
• The first match takes the whole prize
• Won before yours landed? You're refunded

ep05-taking-a-multiwin-02.jpg:
**Four digits, four tiers.**
Each digit that matches the winning number in the same spot counts. The more spots match, the higher the tier.

**1. T4: all four match:** The top tier. Up to 50.00 here.
**2. T1: one matches:** The smallest prize. It can be less than the entry price.
**3. Your four digits:** Type them in, or tap shuffle for random ones.
ep05-taking-a-multiwin-03.jpg:
**Each entry is scored on its own.**
One purchase can hold several winners, and the Chance keeps going.

**1. Winning number: 1789:** One per purchase, four digits.
**2. 1780: three match:** The 1, 7 and 8 are in the right spots. Tier 3.
**3. 1234: one matches:** Only the 1 is in the right spot. Tier 1.
ep05-taking-a-multiwin-04.jpg:
**The top tier says up to.**
Lower tiers pay what the page showed when you bought. The top tier is shared with purchases settling at the same time, so it's a maximum, not a promise.

• Max slippage (1% by default) sets the lowest RTP you'll accept
• Below that, the entry cancels and you keep your tokens
• A cancelled entry still costs gas

**Create a Chance. Or take one.**

ep06-what-an-entry-costs-02.jpg:
**Every entry has three costs.**
The purchase screen shows gas and the randomness fee before you confirm.

**The entry price:** Set by the creator, in the Chance's token. Every card shows it.
**Gas:** A small ETH fee that Robinhood Chain charges to process your entry.
**The randomness fee:** A small ETH fee for the random number that decides your result, paid to the provider Chance runs.
ep06-what-an-entry-costs-03.jpg:
**The 5% fee comes out of the entry price.**
It's not added on top. Here's where one 40 USDG entry goes.

One 40.00 USDG entry:
**38.00 USDG to the creator:** 95%. If they set a referral commission, it comes out of this share.
**2.00 USDG to Chance:** The 5% platform fee, taken only when an entry settles.
ep06-what-an-entry-costs-04.jpg:
**Refunded? Your entry price comes back.**
In full, with no platform fee taken. Gas and the randomness fee were already spent, so they don't come back.

• Free entries still need a little ETH
• Fee rates are locked into each purchase
• Creators pay a one-time 1% on top of the prize they fund

**Create a Chance. Or take one.**
**You decide.**

18+ · Only where permitted
ep07-how-the-winner-is-picked-02.jpg:
**Chance can't pick the winning number.**
It comes from a Chance-operated, commitment-verifiable provider, and every step is on the record.

**1. Commitment:** A sealed promise, published before anyone entered.
**2. Request contribution:** Randomness from the chain at the moment of purchase.
**3. Provider revelation:** The provider's value. A mismatch is rejected.
**4. Random value:** Both combined into the winning number.
ep07-how-the-winner-is-picked-03.jpg:
**Check any result yourself.**
Every entry has a Verify link in the Chance's live feed. It opens this page.

**1. Verified:** Every check passed. A failed check shows Mismatch.
**2. The winning number:** Recomputed from the receipts, right on this page.
**3. The receipts:** Public transactions on Robinhood Chain that anyone can look up.
ep07-how-the-winner-is-picked-04.jpg:
**Honest about the limits.**
The provider can't change a value it promised. It could hold a reveal back, so if no result lands within 10 minutes, the purchase can be refunded instead.

• Built on Pyth's open-source Entropy
• Prize contracts can't be upgraded
• Changes to the randomness contract are public

**Create a Chance. Or take one.**
**You decide.**

ep08-getting-paid-02.jpg:
**Winnings arrive by themselves.**
Nothing to claim. Results usually land within seconds, though a busy network can stretch that.

**1. A live feed of results:** Every Chance shows its wins in public.
**2. The winning wallet:** That's where the payout goes. Nobody approves it.
**3. Paid automatically:** In the same transaction that decides the result.
ep08-getting-paid-03.jpg:
**Stuck? There's a fix.**
Both fixes are on the Player tab of your Dashboard.

**Payout didn't arrive?:** It waits for your wallet only. Use Claimable payouts to retry.
**No result after 10 minutes?:** Use Claim refund. If you don't, a Chance service usually sends it about 10 minutes later.
**Still stuck?:** Ask on Discord or Telegram, with your wallet address and the Chance.
ep08-getting-paid-04.jpg:
**Nobody can redirect your payout.**
Nobody at Chance approves a payment or can send it somewhere else. Payouts and refunds only go to the wallet that entered.

• A loss is a loss, not a refund
• Chance never DMs first. Anyone who does is a scammer

**Create a Chance. Or take one.**
**You decide.**

ep09-creating-a-chance-02.jpg:
**You set the rules.**
Pick Instant Win or MultiWin, fund the prize in any supported token, and choose how long it runs: 1 minute to 30 days.

**1. The prize:** Funded before anyone can enter. At least $100.
**2. Entry price:** At least $1. On Instant Win, at most half the prize.
**3. Win odds:** The chance one entry wins. Here, 1 in 2,500.
**4. RTP:** Worked out as you type. Here, 80%.
ep09-creating-a-chance-03.jpg:
**What's locked, what's not.**
Players see the rules before they enter, and the rules can't move after.

**Locked at launch:** Entry price, odds, duration, tiers and referral %. Not even Chance can change them.
**Yours to change:** The name, image, and your X and Telegram handles. Plus free entries and the invite list.
**Optional extras:** Cap total entries, set a referral commission (up to 20%) or go invite-only.
ep09-creating-a-chance-04.jpg:
**Your risk has a ceiling.**
The most you can lose is the prize you fund plus the 1% deposit fee. Prize left at the end? Withdraw returns it.

• Each paid entry pays you its price, minus 5% and any referral
• No entries? No earnings, and the prize comes back

**Create a Chance. Or take one.**

ep10-sharing-and-referrals-02.jpg:
**Some Chances pay you to share.**
Look for Ref. on a card. The creator sets it, from 0 to 20%.

**1. Ref. 5%:** This Chance pays 5% of the creator's net to whoever brings a player in.

ep10-sharing-and-referrals-03.jpg:

**36.10 USDG to the creator:** Their share, minus your cut.
**1.90 USDG to you:** 5% of the creator's 38.00 net.

ep10-sharing-and-referrals-04.jpg:
**Get your link, share it.**
Tap share on a Chance with Ref., then Generate Link. Every paid entry through it pays you when it settles, straight to your wallet.

• One link per Chance

ep11-points-and-chance-games-02.jpg:
**Points are your score.**
You earn them by playing, creating and finishing quests.

**Play:** 1 Point per $1 on paid entries, times the Chance's RTP. Even a loss earns a little.
**Create:** +25 once 3 players pay to enter, then Points on what your players spend and win.
**Quests and milestones:** One-time rewards, like +150 for your first Instant Win, and bonuses from 5 to 100 plays.
**Free entries earn 0:** Only purchases paid fully with your own funds earn Points.
ep11-points-and-chance-games-03.jpg:
**Where your Points live.**
Two balances: Spendable Points for Chance Games, and Lifetime Points for the leaderboard.

**1. Dashboard:** Your balances, and every Point you've earned or spent.
**2. Rank:** The leaderboard ranks Lifetime Points. Spending never lowers your rank.
**3. Chance Games:** Free-only Chances. Usually 20 Points per entry, up to 5 per claim.
ep11-points-and-chance-games-04.jpg:
**Points are not a token.**
They have no cash value, can't be bought, sold or moved, and never convert into CHANCE.

• Claim within 15 minutes, or your Points come back
• Free entries still need a little ETH for gas
• Values can change between seasons

**Create a Chance. Or take one.**

ep13-staying-safe-02.jpg:
**Who controls what.**
Prizes sit in contracts, not with us. Your wallet stays yours.

**Chance can:** Pause new Chances and entries, set fees within a 10% cap, choose supported tokens and run the randomness provider.
**Chance can't:** Change a prize's terms, cancel a prize, redirect a payout or pick a winning number.
**Paused? Payouts still work:** A pause stops new activity only. Results, refunds and claims keep going.
ep13-staying-safe-03.jpg:
**Help is one tap away.**
Include your wallet address and the Chance involved.

**1. Discord:** Chat with the team and the community.
**2. Telegram:** Official announcements.
**3. Email:** support@ravenshorernd.com, also how you ask for a break.
ep13-staying-safe-04.jpg:
**Play within limits.**
An entry can lose everything you paid, fees included. Need a break? Email support to block your account for 24 hours, or for good.

• Never share your seed phrase
• Anyone who asks for it is a scammer
• Chance never DMs first

**That's Chance 101.**
